about: Face detection's constants that the app and the web app share (docs/shared-code.md, T1.4). Privacy-critical: a change here changes what gets blurred on both platforms. Constants only one platform has stay in its code (the web's reduced mode and pace budget: lib/fusion.ts, lib/pace.ts).

consts.section: The score thresholds at sensitivity 0 (the default) and at 1 (the most): DetectTuning.DEFAULT / MOST, lib/sensitivity.ts DEFAULT_THRESHOLDS / MOST.

consts.name: DEFAULT_CUT
consts.doc: A detection under this is no evidence of a face (the tracker's DET_THRESHOLD).

consts.name: DEFAULT_BIRTH
consts.doc: A detection that starts a new tracklet needs this much.

consts.name: DEFAULT_STRONG
consts.doc: A detection this sure is strong evidence.

consts.name: DEFAULT_VERIFIED
consts.doc: The crop re-check's score that counts as evidence.

consts.name: DEFAULT_SHORT_VERIFIED
consts.doc: The crop re-check's score a very short tracklet needs (twice).

consts.section: Sensitivity above 0: the fixed, lower candidate pool and the extra detections.

consts.name: POOL_RF
consts.doc: RetinaFace's score threshold for the pool.

consts.name: POOL_YUNET
consts.doc: YuNet's score threshold for the pool.

consts.name: POOL_YUNET_ONLY
consts.doc: A face only YuNet finds joins the pool from this score.

consts.name: MAX_EXTRA_CHECKS
consts.doc: Extra detections a frame gets the crop re-check on (the likeliest first).

consts.name: SAME_FACE_IOU
consts.doc: An extra detection overlapping a default one this much (IoU) is that face: not extra.

consts.name: SENSITIVITY_STEPS
consts.doc: Steps of the sensitivity setting (5% each).

consts.section: Detections per second of video: DetectTuning.RATE / MIN_RATE / FAST_RATE, lib/pace.ts, lib/sensitivity.ts.

consts.name: RATE
consts.doc: Normal detection's rate.

consts.name: MIN_RATE
consts.doc: The fewest a slow device goes down to.

consts.name: FAST_RATE
consts.doc: Fast detection's rate: also its floor.

consts.section: RetinaFace + YuNet fusion: DetectTuning.fuse, lib/fusion.ts fuse.

consts.name: FUSE_IOU
consts.doc: A YuNet face overlapping a RetinaFace one more than this (IoU) is the same face.

consts.name: FUSE_YUNET_WEIGHT
consts.doc: YuNet's score's weight in the noisy-or where both agree.

consts.name: FUSE_YUNET_ONLY
consts.doc: A face only YuNet finds is added from this score...

consts.name: FUSE_YUNET_ONLY_SCALE
consts.doc: ...at this share of its score.

consts.name: FUSE_NMS
consts.doc: The fused list's NMS IoU.

consts.section: The detectors: FaceDetector, RetinaFaceDetector, FaceAnalyzer; lib/fusion.ts, lib/detector.ts, lib/pace.ts.

consts.name: RF_THRESHOLD
consts.doc: RetinaFace's score threshold.

consts.name: YUNET_THRESHOLD
consts.doc: YuNet's score threshold.

consts.name: YUNET_NMS
consts.doc: YuNet's own NMS IoU.

consts.name: CLEAR
consts.doc: A face this sure counts as strong evidence by itself: no crop re-check, no "check the faces" flag.

consts.name: GPU_SIDE
consts.doc: The fine pass's long side on the GPU (the frames' long side).

consts.name: CPU_SIDE
consts.doc: The fine pass's long side on the CPU.

consts.name: LOW_SIDE
consts.doc: The fine pass's long side on the CPU when the device can't keep up.

consts.name: COARSE_SIDE
consts.doc: RetinaFace's coarse pass, for faces bigger than the fine pass's anchors.

consts.name: COARSE_MIN_BOX
consts.doc: The coarse pass keeps faces from this many px.

consts.name: VERIFY_SIDE
consts.doc: The crop re-check's side.

consts.name: YUNET_SIDE
consts.doc: YuNet's input side at most.

consts.name: GPU_SLOW_MS
consts.doc: A GPU slower than this per frame (ms), when detection holds the pass back, gives way to the CPU.

consts.name: TRACK_SHORT_N
consts.doc: A tracklet with fewer detections is very short.

consts.name: TRACK_MAX_GAP_S
consts.doc: The longest a tracklet goes without a detection (s).

consts.name: TRACK_GATE
consts.doc: How far (in face sizes) a detection may be from the prediction...

consts.name: TRACK_GATE_PER_S
consts.doc: ...plus this much for each second since the last one.

consts.name: TRACK_SIZE_RATIO
consts.doc: The most a face's size changes between linked detections.

consts.name: TRACK_LINK_GAP_S
consts.doc: Tracklets of one face apart by up to this (s) are joined.

consts.name: TRACK_ABSORB_GAP_S
consts.doc: A weak tracklet within this (s) of an accepted one may be absorbed...

consts.name: TRACK_ABSORB_DIST
consts.doc: ...when it is within this many face sizes of it.

consts.name: TRACK_EXTEND_S
consts.doc: A track's ends are held this long (s).

consts.name: TRACK_SIGMA_POS_S
consts.doc: The smoothing of the position (s).

consts.name: TRACK_SIGMA_SIZE_S
consts.doc: The smoothing of the size (s).

consts.section: Hard cuts between shots: CutDetector (Motion.kt), lib/cuts.ts.

consts.name: CUT_DIFF
consts.doc: A frame this different from the one before (mean absolute difference of 32x18 thumbnails, 0-255)...

consts.name: CUT_CORR
consts.doc: ...whose histogram correlates less than this with the one before is a cut...

consts.name: CUT_DIFF_HARD
consts.doc: ...and one this different is a cut whatever the histogram.
